claims.text: Skin superinfection (eg, yellow crusting suggesting impetigo): bathe in diluted bleach, eg 60 mL (¼ cup) of 6% household bleach in 76 L (20 gallons) of warm water
claims.quote: For skin superinfection (eg, when yellowish crusting suggests impetigo), bathe with diluted bleach (eg, 60 mL [¼ cup] of household bleach [6%] into 76 L [20 gallons] of warm water)

claims.text: AAD guideline: conditional recommendations for bathing, bleach baths and wet dressings
claims.quote: Conditional recommendations are made in favor of bathing, bleach baths, wet dressings
claims.locator: Guidelines of care for the management of atopic dermatitis
